Name: Bejeweled LIVE
Description: PopCap's gem-matching classic with Classic and Action modes, Hypercubes, Flame and Star gems, plus Xbox LIVE achievements.

Achievements.Name: Ultimate Cascade
Achievements.Description: Make a cascade of x8.

Achievements.Name: Hyperblast
Achievements.Description: Clear 12 gems using a single Hypercube.

Achievements.Name: Hypercube Supremo
Achievements.Description: Clear 16 gems using a single Hypercube.

Achievements.Name: Singularity
Achievements.Description: Break the Laws of Physics with 2 Hypercubes and clear the whole board!

Achievements.Name: Chain Reaction
Achievements.Description: Detonate 3 special gems in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Chain Detonation
Achievements.Description: Detonate 5 special gems in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Power Broker
Achievements.Description: Create 2 special gems in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Power Monger
Achievements.Description: Create 4 special gems in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Spectrum
Achievements.Description: Make 3 consecutive matches of the same colour.

Achievements.Name: Spectrum Mastery
Achievements.Description: Make 5 consecutive matches of the same colour.

Achievements.Name: Supernova
Achievements.Description: Activate 4 Star Gems in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Superconductor
Achievements.Description: Destroy a gem of every colour and type in a single move.

Achievements.Name: Burn Notice
Achievements.Description: Attain Blazing Speed.

Achievements.Name: Faster Than Light
Achievements.Description: Attain Blazing Speed twice in a single level.

Achievements.Name: Dynamo
Achievements.Description: Make 5 matches during a cascade.

Achievements.Name: Action Hero
Achievements.Description: Score more than 500,000 points in a single Action mode level.

Achievements.Name: 7th Heaven
Achievements.Description: Complete level 7 in Action mode.

Achievements.Name: Classic Rock!
Achievements.Description: Complete level 10 in Classic mode.

Achievements.Name: Inferno
Achievements.Description: Create 100 Flame Gems.

Achievements.Name: Millionaire
Achievements.Description: Collect 1 million gems.
